content: Targets live in `Makefile`, not `makefile`; a Makefile in prose is no path, but `Make file` is a command.
note: Case-insensitive runner matching is whole-word, so `Makefile` does not start with the runner `make` and stays a known file name; the bare word Makefile has no `/` and gives nothing; `Make file` starts with a runner followed by whitespace.
